messages:
jamie: main CI just went red after the merge. build-step 'core-service:link' failing with linker errors, looks like undefined refs. Anyone free to grab?
ci-bot: [alert] pipeline main #7421 failed at stage: build (core-service:link) — https://ci.redwood.internal/7421/logs
jamie: excerpt from the log: ```/usr/bin/ld: CMakeFiles/core.dir/main.o: in function `main':
main.o:(.text+0x1a3): undefined reference to `serialize_request'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status```
raj: ack. I can take first look. Which commit was merged?
jamie: merged commit abcdef123 from PR 7289 about telemetry changes.
sofia: ping @raj — FYI that PR touched the serialization layer, might be related.
maria: quick thought — could be a missing compile unit or link flag accidentally dropped. I saw a change to CMakeLists in the PR.
raj: running `bazel build //core:core` locally to repro. If someone can trigger a rerun on CI that'd help check flakiness.
alex: rerun triggered: `/ci rerun 7421 --stage build` (submitted by @alex).
ci-bot: rerun scheduled by alex. build queued on linux-x86 pool.
raj: local build reproduces the same undefined ref. grabbing a full objdump to check symbol table.
sofia: if it's reproducible locally, likely not a transient flake. Good to bisect to the offending patch in the PR.
raj: quick grep shows `serialize_request` is defined in serialization.cc but the file was removed from target_sources in the PR. Opening a quick diff.
jamie: oof — that would explain it. can you patch a hotfix or should we revert?
raj: I can prepare a minimal revert patch to restore the source list. Will open PR and request an urgent rollback.
maria: +1 revert then reapply telemetry changes with the proper link updates. I'll prepare test to catch missing source files in CI.
sofia: oncall note: tagging this as high priority, but no public outage. Keep rolling.
alex: created revert PR 7362, added description and CI gate label. URL: https://git.redwood/internal/7362
ci-bot: PR 7362 CI: pending checks.
jamie: thanks everyone. once revert lands, let's rerun main pipeline and close this thread if green.
raj: monitoring the revert CI. If it passes I'll merge and trigger full pipeline.
ci-bot: PR 7362 merged by raj — merge commit fedcba321
alex: triggered full pipeline: https://ci.redwood.internal/7423
ci-bot: pipeline 7423: all stages passed ✅
jamie: great — pipeline back to green. I'll add a follow-up ticket to add a lint that flags removed sources.
sofia: nice quick turn. Thanks @raj @alex @maria
jamie: tagging for postmortem notes: root cause = PR 7289 removed serialization.cc from target_sources; mitigation = revert + adding CI lint.
